title: Annual campus emissions and staff travel (v1)
description: The baseline and every complete twelve-month period of billing months, with campus totals by fuel (scope 1 and 2). Staff travel (scope 3) is a separate block, present only when the parish reports a travel line, and is never added to the campus totals. Unknown extra fields are allowed.

emissions_unit.description: tCO2e: metric tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent.

sample_data.description: True while these are the template's made-up sample numbers, not a parish's own. Optional: when absent, treat as false.

baseline.description: The baseline period, or null when no twelve consecutive billing months are complete for every meter and both fuels.

periods.description: Every complete twelve-month period, oldest first. Empty when there is none. These are rolling twelve-month windows, one per end month, so each overlaps the next by eleven months: they are not separate years and must not be added together. Use baseline as the single figure for the campus footprint.

staff_travel.description: Church-related driving by clergy and staff in an electric vehicle. Scope 3, reported on its own and never added to the campus totals. Absent when the parish does not report a travel line.

avoided_note.description: How to read the avoided figure: compared with a gasoline car, not subtracted from campus totals.

vehicles.description: One entry per vehicle slug that has travel months. Empty when there is none.

vehicle_id.description: A made-up slug; the vehicle model is not published.

counted_in_campus.description: True when the vehicle charges at the church, so its electricity is already in the campus electricity figure.

periods.description: The campus periods that hold at least one travel month for this vehicle.

label.description: Matches the label of a campus period.

complete.description: True when all twelve months of the period are reported. Otherwise the totals cover only the months reported.

tco2e_counted_here.description: Emissions counted here, or null when the vehicle charges at the church and they are already counted in campus electricity.

avoided_tco2e.description: Avoided emissions compared with a gasoline car. Informational.

quantity.description: Energy over the twelve months, in unit.

tco2e.description: Metric tonnes CO2e, rounded to six decimal places.

label.description: The parish's baseline calendar year, such as 2025, for January to December of that year; otherwise first month to last month, YYYY-MM to YYYY-MM.

months.description: The twelve billing months, oldest first.

tco2e_total.description: Scope 1 plus scope 2, metric tonnes CO2e. Never includes staff travel.

estimated_share.description: Fraction of tco2e_total that comes from estimated readings.

includes_estimates.description: True while any reading in the period is an estimate.

provisional.description: True while the figure may still change: any estimated reading, or a baseline that is not yet the parish's baseline calendar year.

basis.description: calendar_ and the parish's baseline year (for example calendar_2025) when January to December of that year is complete, otherwise latest_twelve_billing_months.
